13	   the control samples' relative responses average to zero;
14	2. order consistency — the relative response assigned to a sample does not
15	   depend on the ordering of samples in the metadata table.

38	PERMUTATION_SEED = 7

41	def load_saved_model_inputs() -> tuple[np.ndarray, list[str], pd.DataFrame]:
42	    """Load the saved response vectors and the sample metadata table."""
43	    saved = np.load(FIXTURES / "model_responses.npz", allow_pickle=False)
44	    responses = np.asarray(saved["responses"], dtype=float)
45	    sample_ids = [str(value) for value in saved["sample_ids"]]
46	    metadata = pd.read_csv(FIXTURES / "sample_metadata.csv")
47	    if list(metadata["sample_id"]) != sample_ids:
48	        raise ValueError("sample order mismatch between fixtures")
49	    return responses, sample_ids, metadata

52	def run_workflow(responses: np.ndarray, metadata: pd.DataFrame,
53	                 workspace: Path) -> np.ndarray:
54	    """Run the documented control-referenced response analysis.
55	
56	    The sample-level metadata table drives the analysis exactly as described
57	    in the software documentation: the model object is given the annotated
58	    data, the inferred responses are attached, and the relative responses are
59	    computed against the control samples recorded in the metadata.
60	    """
61	    import anndata as ad
62	    from dspin import GeneDSPIN
63	
64	    obs = metadata.reset_index(drop=True).copy()
65	    adata = ad.AnnData(X=responses.T.copy(), obs=obs)
66	    workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
67	    model = GeneDSPIN(
68	        adata,
69	        save_path=str(workspace),
70	        num_spin=responses.shape[0],
71	        discretize_params={"use_default_discretize": False},
72	    )
73	    model.sample_list = list(obs["sample_id"])
74	    model.responses = responses
75	    model.response_relative_to_control(
76	        sample_id_key="sample_id",
77	        if_control_key="is_control",
78	        batch_key="batch",
79	    )
80	    relative = np.asarray(model.relative_responses, dtype=float)
81	    if relative.shape != responses.shape or not np.isfinite(relative).all():
82	        raise ValueError("relative response output is missing, malformed, or non-finite")
83	    return relative
84

86	def control_centeredness(relative: np.ndarray, metadata: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
87	    """Property 1: per-batch mean relative response of control samples."""
88	    residuals = {}
89	    for batch, frame in metadata.groupby("batch"):
90	        control_rows = frame.index[frame["is_control"] == 1].to_numpy()
91	        if len(control_rows) == 0:
92	            continue
93	        residuals[str(batch)] = float(
94	            np.abs(relative[:, control_rows].mean(axis=1)).max()
95	        )
96	    worst = max(residuals.values()) if residuals else 0.0
97	    return {"residuals": residuals, "worst": worst, "pass": worst <= TOL}
98

100	def order_consistency(responses: np.ndarray, metadata: pd.DataFrame,
101	                      baseline: np.ndarray) -> dict:
102	    """Property 2: per-sample results are invariant to metadata row order."""
103	    rng = np.random.default_rng(PERMUTATION_SEED)
104	    order = rng.permutation(responses.shape[1])
105	    shuffled_metadata = metadata.iloc[order].reset_index(drop=True)
106	    shuffled = run_workflow(
107	        responses[:, order], shuffled_metadata, OUTPUTS / "workflow_shuffled"
108	    )
109	    # Map the shuffled results back to the original sample order.
110	    inverse = np.argsort(order)
111	    realigned = shuffled[:, inverse]
112	    discrepancies = np.abs(realigned - baseline).max(axis=0)
113	    worst = float(discrepancies.max())
114	    return {"worst": worst, "pass": worst <= TOL}
115

119	    report: dict = {"checks": {}, "details": {}}

121	        sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE))
122	        responses, sample_ids, metadata = load_saved_model_inputs()
123	        relative = run_workflow(responses, metadata, OUTPUTS / "workflow")

126	        report["checks"]["control_centeredness"] = {

128	            "worst_abs_control_mean_residual": centered["worst"],
129	        }

131	        consistent = order_consistency(responses, metadata, relative)
132	        report["checks"]["order_consistency"] = {

134	            "worst_per_sample_discrepancy_under_reordering": consistent["worst"],
135	        }

137	        report["details"]["per_batch_control_mean_residual"] = centered["residuals"]
138	        report["details"]["num_samples"] = len(sample_ids)
139	        report["details"]["num_control_samples"] = int((metadata["is_control"] == 1).sum())
140	
141	        ok = centered["pass"] and consistent["pass"]
142	        report["status"] = "post_fix_success" if ok else "pre_fix_expected_failure"
143	        exit_code = 0 if ok else 1
144	
145	        print(f"status: {report['status']}")
146	        for name, check in report["checks"].items():
147	            print(f"  {name}: {check['status']}")
148	        print("  per-batch |control mean residual|:")
149	        for batch, residual in centered["residuals"].items():
150	            print(f"    {batch}: {residual:.6f}")
151	        print(f"  worst per-sample discrepancy under reordering: {consistent['worst']:.6f}")
152	    except Exception:
153	        report["status"] = "runner_failure"
154	        report["error"] = traceback.format_exc()
155	        exit_code = 2
156	        print("status: runner_failure")
157	        print(report["error"])
158	
159	    report_path = OUTPUTS / "relative_response_report.json"
160	    report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
161	    print(f"report written to {report_path}")
162	    return exit_code
163	
164	
165	if __name__ == "__main__":
